# Rainmeter Todo Skin

> Rainmeter Todo Skin ("Todo Board") is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows Rainmeter skin that puts a local-first todo board on your desktop. Todos live in a local tasks.json file and work offline. After a one-time Sign in with Google (OAuth 2.0, built-in client, no Google Cloud project needed), clicking a todo that has no custom link creates a real Google Task via the Google Tasks API; a dated todo becomes an all-day task. Latest version: 1.5.0. Requires Windows 10/11 and Rainmeter 4.5.26 or newer. Not affiliated with Google or Rainmeter.
